items.prompt: An internal cash/PnL identity passes. Why might the ledger still be wrong?
items.modelAnswer: Both sides may share an omitted/duplicate/wrongly priced event, stale mark, wrong account/instrument/currency or missing cash/corporate action. Use independent authoritative reconciliation and declared policy, not internal consistency alone.
